answer: A clone orchard cannot occupy a single climbing lane. An applicant stakes 7.15 POA and draws one of 18 cedar trellis bays in a hillside grove for 14 minutes. When the guide wire hangs at nadir they clip a 9.6 cm internodal tag, bind a 17-bit pith hash of ring count, pubkey, and epoch seed, and seat it in that bay's sap stamp in seconds 25-50. 101 clones would freeze 722.15 POA and need 101 exclusive bays. Auditors replay the bay draw from the seed, regenerate the hash, and measure the tag to 0.1 cm. A reused bay, missed window, or hash clash burns 47% and idles that trellis for 7 epochs.
